_comment: INVALID example — annotated with the specific violations for training/validation-test purposes. Remove _comment and _violations before using as a test fixture; they are not part of the schema (additionalProperties:false would reject them too).
_violations: fallback includes 'model.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5' which is this same model's own model_id, creating a self-referential cycle (violates Model Contract §4 invariant / VAL-149)
capabilities is an empty array — at least one capability is required (violates schema minItems:1 / VAL-146)
cost.currency is missing while cost.unit is 'per_token', so cost cannot be evaluated against Agent cost_limit (violates RULE-081 / VAL-150)
context_window.max_output_tokens is 0, which is below the schema minimum of 1 (violates schema minimum:1 / VAL-148)
routing_policy.tier value 'ultra' is not one of economy|standard|premium (violates schema enum / VAL-153)
priority is 11, outside the 1-10 range (violates schema maximum:10 / VAL-152)
state is 'active' but availability is missing entirely (violates Model Contract §2 required field / VAL-151)
